title: Route_12
lead_summary:
This route connects Lavender Town, Route 11 and Route 13.
A trainer is blocked by the slumbering Snorlax. Once the player plays the Poké Flute and either capture or defeats the Snorlax, the trainer will give the player HM04 Strength.
One of the Fishing Guru lives on this road and gives the Good Rod to the player.

items.name: Water Stone
items.location_details: Given by Fisherman Hank after defeating him.

items.name: HM04 Strength
items.location_details: Given after capturing or defeating the Snorlax that's blocking the route.

items.name: Dragon Scale
items.location_details: Surf West of the Lavender Town Terminal.
